'''Elda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. She was hired to fly [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to [[Kodai]] in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].
